figurative_meaning_en: Laziness in work, indifference, backwardness, slackness
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গদাইলস্করী চালের কারণে কাজগুলো সবসময় দেরি হয়ে যায়।
অফিসে এই গদাইলস্করী চাল চললে কখনো সফলতা আসবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His gadailskori chal causes all tasks to be delayed.
This lazy demeanor in the office will never lead to success.
history: This idiom has evolved into a proverb describing the stereotypical lazy gait or attitude associated with Bengalis in cultural discourse.
note: Refers to a cultural perception of Bengali work ethic, often used humorously or critically.
